eps.d: Ashley porposes to Elaine – yet again. Although the couple live together, Elaine is determined to hang on to her freedom.

Although Ashley and Elaine live together, staying overnight at Ashley's parents always means seprate bedrooms. Ashley issues his mother an ultimatum: a double room, or no more visits. His mother, Mrs. Pearce maintains her principles in a very senaky way.
Ashley and Elaine decide to put their relationship on the line and test it to the limit.
Elaine is critical of Ashley's appearance and behaviour, so he decides to make a few changes.
Ashley is desparate to start a family. Not sharing his enthusiasm for babies, Elaine sures him of his madness by arranging for baby Lawrence to stay the weekend.

Ashley and Elaine decide that an American-style cohabitation contract would free them from all the stupid, petty arguments that every couple has over mundane issues. What sounds good in theory threatens to turn into a disaster.
The highly conventional Ashley still wants to marry the independent Elaine. Of course, the last thing Elaine wants is to settle down... but Ashley won't take no for an answer.
With Elaine just back from India after 6 months she finds Ashley a little bit of a mess and the apartment too She feels the vital spark she had for him is gone but does Ashley feel the same?
An Auld friend from down under turns up to visit Elaine. He's rugged handsome and very polite. Should Ashley be worried he wants more than a friendship from Elaine?
Elaine asks Ashley to pose nude for her art project! does Ashley finally give in to her persuasive ways and what does Ashley ask her to do in return?
Ashley and Elaine decide to be daring have a party So they to pull out all the stops. Sadly barely anyone turns up until the 11th hour is it a rave up after all?
Ashley and Elaine go to the Summer Mystics Psychic fun Fayre. They decided to get their futures predicted by a clairvoyant. But Is she full of it (twaddle) like Ashley thinks she is after all?

Ashley decides to trust his coworkers advice and invests their Money without Elaine's say so! Will Ashley prove Elaine that you can trust some people most of the time or will Elaine prove Ashley that you can trust most people some of the time or none at all?
Ashley has given Elaine a present which Elaine truly detests! Where will this poor unwanted present end up?

Ashley tries to Say it with love by giving Elaine cactus and chutney much to her dismay it's not very romantic. Elaine feels unappreciated and feels like even after being together for 2 years they are turning into Ashley's Mum and Dad Everything Ashley does or tries to do seems to irritate Elaine even more. Luckily for Ashley he gets there in the end.

Ashley and Elaine receive a phone call in the middle of the night from Ashley's Mother, Ashley's auntie Agnes passes away at the age of 96 Ashley who was not even saddened by her death or even bothered about going to her funeral until his mother mentions he maybe left his Aunties will changers his tune rather quickly.

Ashley finds a mobile phone on his way home from work, instead of handing it into the police straight away Ashley decides to do it in the morning, later that evening Ashley answers a mysterious phone call on it.
Ashley and Elaine try a new business venture together! Will they be able to succeed?

With their busy work schedules Ashley and Elaine decide to hire a housekeeper to do light housework chores. Ashley has considered asking Perce but it's his once a year slob out time, his spring muck in! Decisions are difficult as they don't have many applicants except for an old woman with a messy appearance and an overbearing Mary poplins.

Elaine try's to educate Ashley on the harmful fly spray that is bad for the ozone layer and being more ecology friendly and economically smart with buying more organic items like organic foods recycled toilet roll and other items that Ashley thinks is way over the top! Meanwhile Perce is also doing his thing by being more ecology friendly and economically smart and driving Ashley demented!
Ashley and Elaine plan to get married again. This is their second attempt but will it be their last attempt?

Ashley has been getting quite defensive with Elaine and she has no idea why since she doesn't seem to mind him going out with his pals. She finally figures out he's been getting stick off his mates because he and Elaine are a couple. But There is something else about Ashley that is really starting to aggravate her now!
Ashley's school memories come back to haunt him.

Elaine and Karen go jogging together at night and see a flasher. Ashley and Perce go to the park to check if the flasher is still hanging around but the PC misunderstands what they are doing and they get brought in for a lineup. Guess who also gets brought in for the lineup?

Ashley and Elaine have a dungeons and dragons night with another couple. After the game ends and the couple leave, Ashley finds a quest in his game box and becomes obsessed over it, driving Elaine crazy. She finally gives in to help him solve it. but will the quest be all its to be?
